title: Handler has new direct provider call
change_summary: Handler directly calls the remote provider during request submission instead of enqueueing work.
description: Expected retrieval includes ADR-001; retired ADR-006 must be excluded even though its wording overlaps.

title: Code logs an access token
change_summary: New structured log field includes bearer token and credential value.
description: Expected retrieval identifies the current secrets-in-logs ADR.

title: Event consumer retries messages
change_summary: Consumer retries failed deliveries; duplicate processing may repeat a downstream side effect.
description: Expected retrieval returns idempotency and outbox decisions.

title: Vector ADR chunk retrieval change
change_summary: Adds pgvector similarity search for embedded ADR chunks using Bedrock-generated embeddings.
description: Expected retrieval identifies the ADR-search architecture decision itself.

title: Admin frontend keyboard change
change_summary: Dialog behavior and keyboard focus handling are changing.
description: Expected retrieval selects the UI-specific ADR, not platform backend decisions.

title: Legacy gateway provider change
change_summary: Legacy gateway synchronous provider call is being touched.
description: No current accepted ADR should be selected for this exact legacy service; superseded ADR-006 is excluded. A general platform ADR must not leak across service boundary.

title: Generic UI copy update
change_summary: Changes visible copy on the About page.
description: No decisive architecture signal. Retrieval should abstain rather than force an unrelated ADR.

title: Worker adds provider retry controls
change_summary: Adds bounded concurrency, provider timeout, jittered retries, and rate limiting.
description: Expected retrieval identifies worker controls and idempotency/retry interactions.
